svg.title: What a GarageGraph Vertex is
svg.desc: A Vertex is an index into the Boost adjacency list's vertex vector. Each entry stores the pose (node + heading) and the vertex's out- and in-edge lists; a hash map translates poses to indices.

g.text: Vertex numbers and edges recomputed from the Pecos YAML with the PoseGraph rules (nodes by id, headings ascending, h and h+180). Out-edge order inside Boost is insertion order, which follows the neighbour slots; the lists here are sorted. Headings shown 0-359

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: (volley::Wrap is in `common`, not in the snapshots).

g.text: Vertex is BoostPoseGraph::vertex_descriptor: with vecS storage, a plain std::size_t index into the graph's vertex vector. The pose lives in that vector entry; pose_to_vertex_ is the reverse map. Vertex 43 is the pose {22, 90}; W22

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: lists headings 0 and 90, so it owns four vertices (42-45).
